values.quote: become ''Iced'' for 3 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits
values.binNote: Iced duration is not defined in Frostbite's own bin rows; it is a property of Flash Frost/Glacial Storm's mark, not present in the Frostbite spell data shown.

mechanics.claim: Enemies hit by Flash Frost or a fully formed Glacial Storm become Iced for 3 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits, and Frostbite deals double damage to Iced targets.
mechanics.quote: Enemies hit by ''{{ai|Flash Frost|Anivia}}'' or a fully formed ''{{ai|Glacial Storm|Anivia}}'' become ''Iced'' for 3 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits.

mechanics.claim: Frostbite's damage is calculated on impact, not on cast, so the doubled damage requires the Iced mark to still be active when the projectile lands.
mechanics.quote: The damage of ''Frostbite'' is calculated once it hits. If the target's mark from being hit by {{ai|Flash Frost|Anivia}} or a fully formed {{ai|Glacial Storm|Anivia}} wears off while the projectile is traveling, the damage is not doubled.

mechanics.claim: Frostbite can be blocked by spell shields.
